decision: Correct revision 11's manually entered future created_at_utc while preserving its evidence-based decision: reject promotion of 15-minute alignment to an execution gate, veto, ranker, or sizing input. Evidence from occupied symbols, overlapping paths, retrospective slicing, or one direction alone is insufficient.
